LEXTOKYO GHOUL · BREAK THE CHAINS · ACCOUNT PLAN

Free-to-play plan, Nov 9. Path: Anteiku, with Ken [√A] as the Carnival chase. Pull only what you can finish.

Full-build tier (as if 0★, fully built):Smeta coreAstrongBnicheCfillerDdon't invest · USE NOW = strongest with your current stars · BUILD TOWARD = where your crystals and gear go · dashed red = CHASE (not owned yet)

Carnival rule (about 6 days left): open the Carnival banner and count the pulls you need to reach the guarantee. If your Carnival tickets + Diamonds can reach it before it ends, pull, all on Ken [√A]. If they can’t, don’t summon at all. The pull count resets when the Carnival ends, so half a pity is wasted. Keep the Diamonds for the Anniversary Legacy: half the price (3,000 vs 6,000 per 10-pull), and you pick the unit.

Who to chase, cheapest first

Hinami [Halloween]1 · FREE: crystals 2★→3★

Your best unit. At 3★ she can’t be controlled and casts a Lv2 skill at battle start. Every Panacea crystal goes here first.

Toka [Anteiku]2 · SHOP CURRENCY (~day 43)

Shields the whole team every turn. Listed for the day-43 shop in the game files (not seen in-game yet). Costs no Diamonds.

Hinami [Tanabata]3 · LEGACY (60k Diamonds)

All-Anteiku back-up: +10% ATK and pierce for everyone. Recent Legacy pools include her. Nishiki [Anteiku] is the same price and also good.

Ken [√A]4 · CARNIVAL (only at full pity)

The Anteiku carry: a 440% hit that stuns. Creators pair him with June Bride, which you own (Sandro, Jul; Aslan, Jun: "Anteiku is a viable path").

Why Ken over Hideyoshi for Lex (the data)

For KenAgainst / the honest part
Lex’s two best non-Ayato units are Anteiku (Hinami [Halloween] 2★, June Bride). Ken is SSR, so crystals can star him up.Hideyoshi is on more creator teams (16 vs Ken’s 5), and Ken was on 0 of 2 October Anteiku teams.
The Anteiku path keeps improving: Ken + one Legacy pick + Hinami 3★. Hideyoshi has no next step.On its own, neither pull beats Lex’s current team on our tool. The jump comes from Ken plus the Legacy pick, not from Ken alone.

Scores come from RED THREAD’s team-score tool, which undercounts stat buffs like Hinami’s +50%. Arena results beat it.
